events.title: Member’s Draw
events.description: Club SOPO Members Draw: Where Winning is a Tradition!    WEEKLY JACKPOT NOW $6,000 (Next Draw: Wednesday 16th September 2026)     Are you ready to experience the thrill of winning? Look no further than Club SOPO's Members Night, the weekly extravaganza where cash is up for grabs! But that's not all – if luck doesn't find its winner, we'll keep adding $500 to the pot every week until it reaches an incredible $10,000 CASH! When the $10,000 milestone is reached, we guarantee that it will be won as we continue to call each week after we reach the jackpot - until it is won!    Our Member’s Draw is held every Wednesday with the exciting draws scheduled for 7:00pm, 7:30pm and 8:00pm!  One chance to win every half hour!    How to Participate: No entry ticket is required - however members must be present to win! So, make sure you're here to claim your prize!    Not a Member Yet? No Worries!  Becoming a member is a breeze. Simply drop by and meet our friendly reception staff on your next visit. For only $5, you can unlock your Members night entry ticket, plus a world of benefits and discounts, including an instant 10% off in our Seductions Bar, Brews Café and Palm Springs Bistro and invitations to exclusive members only events!    At Club SOPO, we believe in creating unforgettable moments and giving our members every reason to smile. Join us on Members Night for a chance to win big and experience all SOPO has to offer!    Don't miss out on the excitement – mark your calendars for SOPO Members Draw every Wednesday, see you there!    For full T&C's, click here.
